Feature: Independent control register for each GPIO.
Test Description: Validate GPIO_8 to GPIO_27 registers for correct reset defaults and masked write/read behavior. Else read data_rd=read_reg(addr_array[i]); then mask out bit0 via data=(data_rd & 0xFFFFFFFE) to avoid input bit artifacts; compare data against default_value_array[i]; on mismatch, increment def_fail_cnt and log. Write/read check (chk_rd_wr): for each of 6 patterns (0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0xF5F5F5F5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000), write the masked value (data_wr & write_mask_array[i]) to each address where skip_array[i]==0 and write_mask_array[i]!=0; then read back each register where skip_array[i]==0, write_mask_array[i]!=0, and read_mask_array[i]!=0. Compute wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) and expected value as exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])). Read back value data_rd=(read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]) must equal exp_val; otherwise increment wr_fail_cnt and log. At end of test_case(), call finish(0) if both def_fail_cnt and wr_fail_cnt are zero; otherwise finish(1). A soft reset check function is present but compiled out (#ifdef 0).
Remarks: Registers flagged as non-readable or non-writable are skipped accordingly. Bit0 in the default value check is masked off to avoid mismatches due to input behavior. The expected value computation preserves read-only bits using their default values while verifying writable and readable bits against the written pattern. The test iterates over the provided GPIO_8 to GPIO_27 register set; iteration count should align with the provided arrays.

1. For each of GPIO_8 to GPIO_27 registers, if the register is readable and not marked to skip, read the register and compare its default value while ignoring bit0 of the read value.
